facts.fact: NIA Executive Secretary Kenneth Attafuah said in an interview reported on 2 February 2024 that institutions on the NIA personal verification platform verify the identities of people who transact with them in real time.

Attafuah said the Bank of Ghana, all 24 universal banks, 145 rural banks, about eight savings and loans companies and about 14 other centres have been onboarded onto the NIA verification platform, 191 institutions in all.

facts.fact: NIA Executive Secretary Kenneth Attafuah said banks and other financial institutions verify clients' identities against the NIA database in real time for know-your-customer checks.

Attafuah said the Bank of Ghana, 24 universal banks, 145 rural banks, about eight savings and loans companies and about 14 other centres are onboarded, and the NIA put the total at 191 financial institutions.

GHA.note: The document gives no survey figure on payments use.
The document mentions transfers from bank accounts to mobile money wallets only as a context for fees and describes no retail payment service.
The document says nothing about paying taxes or fees electronically.
